routines.text: Arịrịọ e zigara n’onwe ha, n’oge a haziri. Ọ dịghị ihe na-arụ mgbe taabụ a mechiri emechi: ihe ruru oge mgbe ahụ ka a na-eme mgbe ị lọghachiri.
routines.none: Enweghị ọrụ nhazi oge ka ugbu a. Rịọ ka e mee ihe kwa awa, kwa ụbọchị, kwa izu ma ọ bụ kwa ọnwa, ma ọ bụ ka e chetara gị ihe n’ụtụtụ Tọzdee.
routines.starter.news.request: Akụkọ dị mkpa taa, n’isi ihe ise dị mkpụmkpụ, nke ọ bụla na isi mmalite ya.
routines.starter.week.request: Jụọ m ihe m nwere n’izu a, wee nyere m aka hazie ya: ihe na-ebu ụzọ na ihe nwere ike ichere.
routines.starter.review.request: Nyere m aka leghachi anya n’izu m: ihe e mechara, ihe ka na-emeghe, na ihe m ga-ebuga n’izu na-abịa.
routines.starter.learn.request: Kụziere m otu ihe bara uru n’ime nkeji ise, n’isiokwu dị iche kwa ụbọchị.
routines.when.file: Oge ọ bụla e kesara faịlụ
routines.when.made: Oge ọ bụla e mere faịlụ
routines.when.back: Oge ọ bụla ị lọghachiri mgbe obere oge gachara
routines.if: Naanị ma ọ bụrụ na azịza bụ ee maka
routines.brain.yours: Otu ihe ahụ dị ka ozi gị
routines.name: Aha
routines.late: Oge agafeela: e mechiri taabụ a na {time}
